<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (twice), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, 116.65 (twice). Counting each carbon represented by these peaks gives 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
